sourceTitle: Fresh Tomatoes With Beans and Macaroni
sourceText:
Fresh Tomatoes With Beans and Macaroni
By: Lady Catherine ...
Published: Tuesday, September 14, 2010 - 5:04pm

Ingredients




1 pound of your favorite macaroni
a pint of fresh cherry tomatoes- halved
1 can large of cannellini beans – drained
1 cup of chicken broth
Handful of sun dried tomatoes – sliced
5 cloves of garlic – crushed& chopped
Handful of fresh parsley – chopped
Handful of fresh basil – chopped
2 tablespoons of marinated peppers – sliced
2 slices of fresh lemon
Olive oil
Grated Romano cheese
Dashes of red pepper flakes

Preparation

1 In a large frying pan heat a few drizzles of olive oil and add the tomatoes, garlic, parsley and basil.  Sauté and add the sun dried tomatoes and the peppers continue to sauté and add the beans and chicken broth.  Add a few dashes of red pepper flakes and another drizzle of olive oil.  Continue to simmer for another minute and then remove from the heat and add the slices of lemon. 2 Prepare the macaroni as directed.  Drizzle the bottom of the serving plate with olive oil, a few dashes of red pepper flakes and some grated cheese add the macaroni and toss. Top with the beans and tomatoes and repeat the process of a drizzle of olive oil, red pepper flakes and grated cheese.

About


You have just created a most delicious and satisfying dish.  I hope you like it.
Enjoy with Love,
Catherine
